scope: Narrow static adaptation review of the unsealed cold-only R36 qualification collector and pure local ACTUAL sealer. This is not a qualification, archive execution, or performance result.

actual_installation.large_request_fingerprint_values: Not used, copied, or reserialized by this review; whole raw original text hashes were checked.

selection.installed_member_identity_comparison: Every original installation receipt member equals the corresponding collector PINNED bytes/SHA256.
selection.candidate: Twelve frozen candidate members including the package manifest, the accepted R24 baseline, exactly two production/test source paths, and the two actual new test names; no D2 diagnostic source or old R36 audit-cache source is substituted.
selection.source_and_harness: Successful collection requires all 220 final compile-input paths, including original Python inputs, plus all 19 original qualification harness files. Source input/tested/after, final map and accepted R24-plus-two-path construction are bound.
selection.logs: All eight qualification-stage original stdout/stderr logs remain hashed against the original report. Full isolated-test input inventory and every compressed original stdout/stderr case log remain checked against the already-run original audit, without decompressing cases or executing that auditor.
selection.elf_scope: The three retained runtime digests are taken from and checked against actual original qualification receipts. No large test ELF or runtime ELF body is reread by this collector.
selection.archive_sources: The collector itself is not selected into its own archive; the existing private-key scanner remains unchanged.

cold_only_adaptation.historical_owner_evidence: The 28 D2 owner references remain historical document provenance. No absent D2 target or cache transfer is asserted.
cold_only_adaptation.prior_failure: The original distinct pre-qualifier wrapper failure 1a1b1bedd38-fc05-7a99 is named in the successful cold preparation history; this first cold qualification is not mislabeled as a benchmark rerun. Its former ROOT and evidence are not altered.
cold_only_adaptation.future_fields: The four pre-execution actual_r36_* input fields remain null. Qualification counts, native outcome and three ELF digests are populated only from later original receipts.

static_checks.collection_nested_reader_and_directory: Preserved by the whole collect() namespace-only comparison.
static_checks.isolated_audit_tail: Read and compared to the D2 reference; the original test inventory/gzip-log and runtime-digest checks are retained.
static_checks.security_io: Original stable descriptor/path stamps, regular/nlink checks, no-follow reader, credential-name and private-key scanning, create-only archive outputs, bounded gzip/tar validation and zero-extraction verification remain in the inherited functions.
static_checks.future_guard: ACTUAL is None in the source. Public summary/collection/create/verify paths retain the unsealed guard before collection/output.

sealer_review.input: Exact seven future paths; original preparation/native-terminal/full native-read mandatory. A success requires all seven actual receipts.
sealer_review.outcome: Taken from the original complete, durable, nontruncated native terminal and original full stream. No qualification success or count is supplied by the template.
sealer_review.successful_bindings: Eight actual zero stage return codes, real source map, real isolated summary/audit, actual three-runtime inventory; no preselected numeric test count.
sealer_review.failure_behavior: A failed original terminal remains failed. Later receipts may be absent; available failed-stage fields and raw evidence are retained without upgrading failure to success.
sealer_review.source_injection: One AST assignment named ACTUAL, required to be the original None; the sealer parses resulting source but does not import or execute it.
sealer_review.output: Fresh absolute create-only directory with collector, actual-pins.json and seal-manifest.json; originals and template are reread before writing.
sealer_review.boundaries: The sealer does not claim that the target archive or future qualification has already run. Installation evidence is rehashed by collection.

review_limits: All four source bodies and the original 4357-byte installation receipt plus four installation/launch raw documents were independently fetched and Git/SHA256/length checked.

The 22 installed-member identities were independently compared to PINNED and the frozen candidate/input interfaces were read; this review does not claim a new full reread of every selected future file or every one of the 30 static bodies.

Only local AST/text/JSON/hash operations were performed. No target module was imported, no collector/sealer/auditor/qualifier was run, and no host call, compiler, test, benchmark, Git tree or ref mutation occurred.
